Dr. William Sung is highly regarded in the field of cosmetic dentistry, known for his commitment to patient-centered care and meticulous attention to detail. With extensive training in advanced cosmetic procedures, Dr. Sung has helped countless patients in Richmond, TX, achieve their ideal smiles. Trust in his expertise to guide your dental care journey with precision and compassion. You can also schedule virtual consultations with Dr. Sung.

Dr. Van Nguyen, originally from Vietnam and raised in a small town in Minnesota, earned her Doctor of Dental Surgery degree from the University of Minnesota. Inspired by her hometown dentist, Dr. Nguyen is passionate about building lasting relationships with her patients and guiding them on their oral health journeys. With a love for art and precision, Dr. Nguyen excels in restorative and cosmetic dentistry and stays current with new techniques through continuing education.
